about: A subspace relay: an unmanned, pure-solar relay platform, one a star system (placed by its starsystem file), linking every station in the system into one data network, and the systems to each other. Its transceiver (the subspace subsystem) needs power: without it, its links lose signal. A maintenance console (Bridge 1) to tend its grid; no weapons, warp, impulse or transporter; never docked with or towed.
name: Subspace Relay
